a Nasdaq extension through December 2, 2026 to regain compliance with listing rule.
The rule requires Exicure to maintain at least $2.5M in stockholders’ equity.
The company also previously failed Nasdaq’s alternative listing standards based on market value of listed securities or net income.
Failure to meet the requirements could result in delisting proceedings, although Exicure would have the right to appeal to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

title: Exicure gets Nasdaq compliance extension
